title: Images and files travel both ways between the phone app and the Assistant

requirements.text: A file the Assistant sends with SendUserFile reaches the phone app as an image (or file) in the conversation
requirements.check: node --test mobile/bridge/test (e2e: SendUserFile in transcript -> phone receives reassembled bytes)

requirements.text: A file sent while the phone app is in the background is delivered when it comes back
requirements.check: node --test mobile/bridge/test (hello with older lastSeen replays the file)

requirements.text: TJ can attach a photo on the phone; it is saved on the laptop and the Assistant's prompt names its path
requirements.check: node --test mobile/bridge/test (phone file chunks + say -> tell text contains saved path, bytes equal)

requirements.text: The phone app shows received and sent images inline and opens them full size on tap
requirements.check: manual: installed on Pixel, image bubble visible

requirements.text: Phone app builds and is installed on the Pixel

evidence: e2e 'a file the Assistant sends with SendUserFile reaches the phone whole': 500000 bytes, 3 chunks via wrangler-dev relay, reassembled bytes equal, name/mime/caption carried
e2e 'a phone that was in the background gets the file when it comes back': hello with lastSeen 10 min old -> 3 chunks of toolu_X-0 resent

e2e photo test: 450000-byte JPEG in 3 chunks -> saved under phone/files/...IMG_2041.jpg, bytes equal; tell text '[phone] what do you think of this (TJ attached a file from the phone: /path...)'; missing attachment -> error 'did not arrive whole'

text: Bridge (files.mjs, follower SendUserFile, outbox replay) live and 21/21 tests; phone app built 17:29 with attach button, image bubbles, FileProvider open. NOT installed: Pixel's wireless debugging dropped (tunnel 127.0.0.1:15555 -> 10.0.0.203:36461 offline, no mdns). Also: queued_command [phone] now fires started cue.

Also built: readouts take transient audio focus (USAGE_ASSISTANT speech) so Spotify etc pause, released when the last queued reply finishes or Stop. APK 17:40 compiles. Still not installed: Pixel unreachable (no mdns, tunnel offline).
Also built: Status update button always pressable, with a dot (pulsing green connected+laptop online, amber connecting, red down). APK 17:47 compiles. Still not installed: Pixel unreachable.
Shipped to R2 link (version 0.1.453529, 16540007 bytes, checked online) at TJ's request from the phone; he installs it himself. Next: Tally resends front_door_open.png to test.
Audio hold now shared (AudioHold.kt): mic, waiting-after-dictated-send, reply readout; released 1.5s after the last. Shipped new build to the R2 link.

evidence: TJ on Pixel, build 0.1.453531 (relayed by Tally): front_door_open.png resent via SendUserFile shows inline and opens full size on tap - 'Yes and yes nice work'
assembleDebug ok; shipped to R2 link 0.1.453531 (16542231 bytes, checked online); TJ installed it and tested on the Pixel

text: Verified on Pixel 0.1.453531: image to phone inline+full size ('Yes and yes nice work'); mic tap pauses music ('mic test worked music paused'). Not yet reported by TJ: photo from phone to Tally on a real phone, connection dot, readout pause.

answers.observed: e2e 21/21 via local relay; TJ on Pixel 0.1.453531: image inline + full size, mic pauses music
answers.cause: images never reached the phone because the follower only forwarded text; SendUserFile went to Remote Control only (read in transcript: tool_use input.files)
answers.absence: phone->laptop photo, the connection dot and readout pause are proved by tests/compile only, not yet on the real phone
answers.assumption: real relay accepts 256KB messages as wrangler dev did; if not, phone->laptop photos fail with Retry
answers.falsify: TJ attaches a photo on the phone and Tally does not get a path, or the dot stays red while replies arrive
